projects.name: IcM Outage Automation - Microsoft Identity LiveSite
projects.description: A six-phase outage-management system that automates incident ingestion, enrichment, classification, validation, escalation, and reporting for Microsoft Identity LiveSite operations.
projects.problem: Severity 0-2 incident review required coordinated processing across more than 70 services, multiple data sources, DRI workflows, and operational reports.
projects.approach: Built event-driven Python Azure Functions and KQL workflows, added Azure OpenAI classification, automated Logic Apps escalation, and provisioned secure infrastructure with Bicep and managed identity.
projects.impact: Delivered a production-oriented workflow supporting Severity 0-2 incidents across 70+ Microsoft Identity services with automated reporting and operational runbooks.
architecture: Python Azure Functions and KQL workflows for IcM data processing
Azure OpenAI for root-cause and recurring-outage pattern classification
Logic Apps for DRI notifications and escalation workflows
Service Bus and Blob Storage for event-driven processing and report storage
Managed identity, Key Vault, and Entra ID for secure service access
Application Insights for monitoring and troubleshooting
deliverables: Excel and Word reports for incident review and operational reporting
highlights: Implemented six phases covering incident ingestion, enrichment, classification, validation, escalation, and reporting.
Integrated Azure OpenAI for root-cause and recurring-pattern classification.
Automated DRI notifications and generated Excel and Word reports for incident review.
Provisioned Key Vault, Blob Storage, Service Bus, Application Insights, and Entra ID integrations through Bicep.

projects.name: JobPilot: AI-Powered Job Application Co-Pilot
projects.imageAlt: JobPilot job-search dashboard showing role search and application tools
projects.description: A lightweight, browser-only application that streamlines the job search through AI automation. JobPilot aggregates listings from Adzuna, JSearch, and USAJobs so users can find roles and optimize their application materials in one place.
projects.problem: Job seekers must move between fragmented job boards and repeatedly tailor application materials while protecting sensitive resumes and API credentials.
projects.approach: Built a browser-first JavaScript and Python experience with a Cloudflare Worker proxy, multi-source job aggregation, AI-assisted tailoring, and client-side AES-GCM encryption.
projects.impact: Combined search, resume tailoring, and privacy-preserving storage into one deployable workflow without a traditional application database.
highlights: Aggregates job listings from Adzuna, JSearch, and USAJobs into a single search experience.
Static site generated with Python and hosted on GitHub Pages, paired with a thin Cloudflare Worker proxy to eliminate a traditional backend database.
Zero-trust, client-side security model: Anthropic API keys and user resumes are encrypted with AES-GCM and stored via direct Google Drive integration for complete user privacy.

projects.name: 🛡️ Sentinel: Autonomous DevOps Orchestrator [WIP]
projects.description: An AI-driven bridge between Jira and GitHub designed to automate the manual overhead of the DevOps lifecycle, taking tickets from 'To Do' to 'Done' with minimal human intervention. Associated with Quadrant Technologies.
projects.problem: Engineering teams lose time transferring context and status between Jira, source control, coding agents, and CI/CD systems.
projects.approach: Designed an event-driven orchestration layer using Azure OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, OAuth-scoped automation, and an MCP server for agent tool access.
projects.impact: Automated ticket polling, branch and pull-request creation, implementation handoff, and approval-aware workflow progression.
highlights: Autonomous polling that scans Jira boards every 30 seconds for new tickets.
AI-powered implementation using Azure OpenAI and GitHub Copilot to analyze repository structures and generate context-aware code fixes.
Automated PR management: creates feature branches, triggers Copilot, and manages the approval/merge flow once CI/CD checks pass.
Multi-tenant architecture with per-user GitHub OAuth so actions run securely under individual user contexts.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets AI agents like Claude or VS Code Copilot interact directly with the orchestration tools.

projects.name: Image Denoising using Deep Learning
projects.description: Developed ConvIR, a deep learning framework for image denoising targeting additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) using a dual-domain learning approach. Associated with California State University, Northridge.
highlights: Implemented a composite loss function incorporating pixel-wise MSE, FFT-based spectral loss, and noise estimation regularization for spatial and frequency fidelity.
Designed a UNet-inspired convolutional network with skip connections, multi-shape attention, and frequency-aware branches, trained across noise intensities (σ=1.5 to σ=25).
Achieved PSNR gains exceeding 12 dB at high noise levels and a 95% reduction in residual noise under low-noise conditions.
Trained on Set12, BSD68, and Urban100 datasets, reaching >30 dB PSNR at σ=7.5 and ~28 dB PSNR at σ=10.
